title: US-short §9 action layer governance — const-pins the final_action→price one-to-one map (§9/§6.1, '避免状态/价位脱钩'), the 5-group 保命优先 action_rank skeleton, and the observe_reason_type vocab
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §9 final_action→price-field correspondence the design explicitly locks to avoid state/price decoupling (建仓/加仓→entry; 减仓→take_profit_reduce_price; 清仓-止损→stop_clear_price; 清仓-止盈→take_profit_exit_price; 清仓-事件→event_clear_reference_price; 持有/观察/否决-避开→none), the §6.1 holding-exit price field meanings, the §9 survival-first 5-group action_rank skeleton (grouping NOT weighting), and the §9 observe_reason_type vocab. So batch-2 (engine) and batch-3 (renderer/validator) cannot couple an action to the wrong price level or reorder the survival-first skeleton. draft-07 cannot express: byte-faithfulness to §9/§6.1, final_action == action_table == converter TRADE_ACTIONS, sell price targets ⊆ holding-exit fields ⊆ action_table columns, observe_reason_type == action_table — enforced in tests.

final_action_price_map.description: §9 final_action 词表 — one-to-one with §6.1 price levels. price_target = the holding-exit field, 'entry' (建仓/加仓 entry-price complex), or null; carries_observe_reason true only for 观察.
